What a quandary. What should I do?
strings.나린, 무슨 고민이라도 있어요? 나린 한숨에 주위에 있던 얼음이 다 녹고: Narin, is something troubling you? Your sighs are melting all the ice nearby.
Oh, if I keep this up, Gerda will grow unsettled too. I must collect myself.
strings.나린, 그 주문 같은 말은 무엇이옵니까? 아니, 뭐에요? 어?: Narin, what manner of incantation is that? I mean, what is it? Huh?
strings.(나린이 이상한 주문을 끝내고 기지개를 켜자 게르다 하늘에 시원하고 산뜻: (After finishing the strange chant, Narin stretches. A cool, refreshing wind blows across Gerda's sky.)
Long ago, when I first met Io, she taught me that spell to lift my spirits.
strings.처음엔 뭐 이런 애가 다 있나 싶었는데, 하다 보니 효과가 자연스레 생겼: At first, I wondered what sort of child she was. But as I kept using it, it began to work naturally.
It does not increase elemental damage, penetration, or movement speed, mind you.
strings.그냥 해본 말이옵니다. 후후. 저 나린, 부탁이 하나 있사온데 괜찮으신지: Merely a jest. Hehe. I, Narin, have a favor to ask. Would you hear it?
Tell me what it is first.
With Io absent, this seems the perfect time to speak.
strings.이오의 부친이신 이나코스 아저씨와 아르고스 아저씨는 절친이셨습니다. 그래: Io's father, Inachus, and Argos were close friends. Whenever anything happened in the village, they would discuss it together.
strings.특히 아르고스 아저씨께선 힘쓰는 일에는 항상 자신을 불러달라고 할 정도로: Argos was especially devoted to Gerda. He always insisted they call on him whenever strength was needed.
strings.그래서 이나코스 아저씨가 솜씨를 발휘해 얼음 조각이나 장식품을 만들어 아: So Inachus used his skill to make ice sculptures and ornaments as gifts for Argos.
He even made the ring with which he proposed to Melia himself.
strings.제 기억엔 그 일이 일어나기 얼마 전까지만 해도 이오를 위한 것도 만드시: As I recall, shortly before that incident, he was making something for Io as well.
strings.그래서 그것을 찾고 싶사옵니다. %s 님의 발걸음이 닿는 '이면'에 그것: I wish to find it. If a memory of it remains on the "Reverse Side" your footsteps can reach, %s...
You care about Io deeply, Narin.
strings.후후, 나린나린나리링 같은 엉터리 주문을 알려주던 아이니까요. 제가 부탁: Hehe. She is the child who taught me such nonsense as "Narin, Narin, Nariring," after all. Since I am asking the favor, I shall certainly reward you.
strings.정령이 신뢰하는 모험가님을 위한 쿠폰! 여신님께서도 인증하는 것이니 확실: A coupon for an adventurer trusted by the spirits! The goddess herself certifies it, so you may be assured of its worth.
strings.쿠폰! 쿠폰의 효과는 확실히 좋았어요. 흠, 그러면 아르고스가 있던 감옥: A coupon! Those really were useful. Hmm, then I'll visit the prison where Argos was.
I wish I could accompany you, but even a spirit like me cannot reach that realm...
It's all right, Narin. I'll be back.
strings.오셨군요, %s 님. 다행히 아직 이오는 도착하지 않았…. 손에 쥐신 그: You've returned, %s. Fortunately, Io has not yet... What is that in your hand...?
I found this in the room where Argos was.
strings.(나린이 %s에게 목걸이를 받아들고 살펴본다.): (Narin accepts the necklace from %s and examines it.)
strings.이건 데보라가 품고 있던 최고의 얼음으로 만든 것이지요. 하지만, 녹고: This was made from the finest ice Deborah held. But it appears to be melting.
I shall try to freeze it again.
Oh dear... My power has no effect...
That wretched creature must have done something to this necklace.
Then we'll need Echo's power to undo it.
Yes. Though I wonder whether anything bearing Echo's power remains at the spring.
I'll go and look. Wait here. I'll hurry back before Io arrives.
strings.%s 님, 감사하옵니다. 어, 벌써 가시다니…. 정말 추진력이 좋은 분이: Thank you, %s. Oh, already gone... Such decisiveness.
Sigh. I wanted to finish before Io returned...
Those snow-laden clouds riding the wind... She must have finished her work...
strings.에코의 것인지는 모르겠지만, 수상한 물건이 있어서 가져왔어요. 어, 이: I don't know if it belonged to Echo, but I found something suspicious and brought it back. Oh, Io...
I heard. You went back to that sinister place because Narin asked...
The first time was at your request, was it not?
Oh, right. Sorry we're such a troublesome human and spirit.
I promised a spirit's coupon of trust as a reward.
strings.착한 일하면 정령이 주는 쿠폰이라니…. 그래도 정령왕님께서 주시는 거니: A coupon from a spirit for good deeds...? Still, if a Spirit King gives it, it must work, right?
strings.(나린이 두루마리를 펼치고 얼음 목걸이와 얼음 거울을 함께 둔다.): (Narin spreads out a scroll and sets the ice necklace and ice mirror upon it.)
strings.그동안 두루마리의 사용법을 익혔나 봐?: You've learned how to use the scroll?
Somehow, I keep finding new applications for it.
strings.(나린이 손을 뻗자 얼음 거울이 갈라지더니 여러 개의 조각으로 나뉜다.): (Narin extends a hand. The ice mirror cracks and splits into several pieces.)
strings.이 얼음 거울은 부정한 기운이 하나도 없네. 이러면 이 목걸이, 녹지 않: There's no tainted energy in this mirror. Does that mean the necklace won't melt now?
Yes. Use these ice fragments to freeze the necklace yourself.
strings.(나린이 이오의 두 손을 모으고 그 안에 목걸이와 얼음 조각을 올려놓는다: (Narin brings Io's hands together and places the necklace and ice fragments within them.)
strings.(나린이 고개를 끄덕이자 이오 또한 고개를 끄덕인다. 잠시 후, 이오의: (Narin nods, and Io nods in return. A small blizzard rises around Io and flows into her hands.)
strings.(이오가 손안에서 목걸이를 살짝 흔들어 보인다. 처음 봤을 때보다 더욱: (Io gently shakes the necklace in her hands. It shines with a purity and clarity greater than when it was first found.)
Made from the purest ice in the Deborah Snowfields.
strings.…그건 됐어. 그래서 여기 뭐가 쓰여 있는 거야? 너무 작아서 잘 안 보: ...Never mind that. What's written here? It's too small to read.
No wonder your eyesight suffers when you shut yourself away researching. Wait a moment.
strings.나린, 왜 그래? 뭐라고 쓰여 있는데, 그런 표정이야?: Narin, what's wrong? What does it say to make you look like that?
strings.「북해 이오니아를 닮은 내 딸 이오니스에게….」: 「To my daughter Ionis, who resembles the northern sea of Ionia...」
strings.이 정도의 순수한 결정을 품었다면 정령만이 가능했을 게다. 그때는 내가: Only a spirit could have helped form a crystal this pure. At the time, I could do nothing...
He must have spoken of you while helping Echo. But Echo...
strings.%s 님, 잠깐 자리를 비켜주셨으면 하옵니다. 좀 지나면 이오가 부를테니: %s, please give us a moment. Io will call for you shortly. Come to her mansion when she does.
I'll see you in a little while...
strings.(이오가 아무런 말도 하지 못하고 고개를 푹 숙이고 있다. 나린이 그런: (Io bows her head, unable to speak. Narin approaches and gently embraces her.)
strings.이런 널 보며 내 쉬이 말이 나오지 않는구나. 허나 널 위해 할 수 있는: Seeing you like this, I struggle to find words. But there is something I can do for you.
strings.비록 사람처럼 온기로 감싸줄 수는 없지만, 그래도 곁을 내어줄 수는 있으: I cannot wrap you in human warmth, but at least I can stay beside you...
Io... Just for this moment, set your burdens down.
strings.(눈보라를 몰고 왔던 구름에서 천천히 가는 빗줄기가 떨어진다. 잿빛 구름: (The clouds that brought the blizzard release a gentle rain. Beneath their ash-gray cover, white Gerda takes on shades of gray.)
It feels so lonely... As though the sky is crying.
Will Io be all right? Oh, over there...
strings.(%s의 시야에 저 멀리서 이오가 손짓하는 것이 보인다.): (%s spots Io beckoning from the distance.)
strings.(이오가 %s의 모습을 보자마자 미안한 표정을 짓는다.): (The moment Io sees %s, she looks apologetic.)
First sending you away, then calling you back... I'm sorry to be so changeable.
strings.저는 괜찮은데, 이오는 괜찮아요?: I'm all right. Are you, Io?
strings.난 괜찮아. 가끔 괜찮지 않을 때도 있지만, 늘 괜찮을 거야. 봐, 지금: I'm fine. Sometimes I'm not, but I'll always be all right in the end. Look, I'm fine now.
Io, your eyes are as swollen as packed snowballs. So very swollen.
strings.나린, 너 그러면 얼려버린다?: Narin, keep that up and I'll freeze you.
You think I would stand idly by? I'll summon ice from somewhere and...
Sigh... All right. Let's stop. Anyway... Thank you, %s!
Because of Narin and me, you haven't even had a chance to visit your goddess.
It's all right. Iris would say the same.
strings.…그러게. 방금 순간적이지만 이오 님, 저는 괜찮아요 라고 하신 것 같아: ...She would. For just a moment, I thought I heard her say, "Io, I'm all right."
Really. I've been hearing the goddess's voice longer than you have, %s.
strings.이오, 나이 많은 거 티 내는 게냐?: Io, are you showing off your age?
strings.나린 말은 신경 쓰지 말고, 게르다에서 종종 봤으면 좋겠어. 무슨 어려운: Ignore Narin. I'd like to see you in Gerda often. If you have any trouble, tell me right away.
I've spoken to Galette. Whenever you come to Gerda, make yourself at home at Snowflower. I'll cover it for the rest of your life.
It's nothing. You're very kind to me.
Thank you. I'll go rest for a while, then. See you later.
strings.(어, 그런데 뭔가 빼먹은 느낌이 드네. 뭐지…?): (Huh? I feel like I've forgotten something. What is it...?)
strings.(이오와 나린이 설화로 향하는 %s에게 손을 흔든다.): (Io and Narin wave to %s as the adventurer heads toward Snowflower.)
strings.대충 이야기는 들었지만, 그 쿠폰 찍는 정령의 도장이란 거 말이야. 그게: I heard the broad story, but that spirit stamp you use on the coupons... Why did it start with Medea and end up in your hands?
Hmm... I don't know either. Though we can certainly wonder...
strings.후우, 그래야 할 것 같아. 에코 일 때문에 그동안 너무 신경을 못 썼어: Sigh. I suppose we should. I've been so distracted by Echo that I haven't paid enough attention. I'd better get moving tomorrow.
strings.%s에게 도장찍은 쿠폰 줬어?: Did you give %s the stamped coupon?
